tests.name: BGP neighbor down — show config and status
tests.input:
BGP neighbor 10.0.0.2 is down on CORE-RTR-01, show me the config and status.

--- show ip bgp summary — CORE-RTR-01 ---
hostname CORE-RTR-01
BGP router identifier 10.255.0.1, local AS number 65412
Neighbor        V  AS    MsgRcvd  MsgSent  TblVer  Up/Down  State/PfxRcd
10.0.0.2        4  65413       0        0        0  never   Idle
10.0.0.6        4  65414   84291    81023   32104   6w2d    218
172.16.255.2    4  65412  192041   189321   32104   12w1d   412

--- relevant config ---
router bgp 65412
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 remote-as 65413
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 description TRANSIT_COGENT_PRIMARY
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 password 7 0529213F2D4D4C1C
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 ebgp-multihop 2
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 update-source Loopback0
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 route-map RM-COGENT-IN in
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 route-map RM-COGENT-OUT out

--- show ip interface brief ---

GigabitEthernet0/0/0   10.0.0.1        YES NVRAM  up                    up
GigabitEthernet0/0/1   10.0.0.5        YES NVRAM  up                    up
GigabitEthernet0/0/2   198.51.100.14   YES NVRAM  up                    down
Loopback0              10.255.0.1      YES NVRAM  up                    up
